title: STORING UP IN THE GOOD YEARS

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "During the seven years of abundance the land produced plentifully. Joseph collected all the food produced in those seven years of abundance in Egypt and stored it in the cities. In each city he put the food grown in the fields surrounding it. Joseph stored up huge quantities of grain, like the sand of the sea; it was so much that he stopped keeping records because it was beyond measure." - Gen 41:47-49 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The seven years of plenty arrive, and Joseph goes to work. Faithfully, systematically, he collects and stores the surplus grain, city by city, until the reserves are "like the sand of the sea" — so vast he stops even keeping records. He does not squander the abundance or assume the good times will last forever. He prepares, diligently, for the famine he knows is coming.

There is wisdom and discipline here worth admiring. When the harvests were overflowing, it would have been easy to relax, to consume, to enjoy without thought for tomorrow. Instead, Joseph worked hard through the good years, laying up reserves for the lean years ahead. He knew that today's abundance was meant, in part, to provide for tomorrow's need.

This is a picture of faithful stewardship. What God gives us in seasons of plenty is not only for our present enjoyment; it is also entrusted to us to steward wisely — to save, to share, to prepare. The one who lives only for today, spending every good thing the moment it comes, will be caught empty when hard times arrive.

Consider your own "years of abundance" — whatever God has given you of resources, health, time, or opportunity. Are you stewarding them wisely, or consuming them thoughtlessly? Like Joseph, work faithfully in the good seasons and lay up what will sustain you and others when leaner days come. Diligence today is provision for tomorrow.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I stewarding my "years of abundance" wisely?
2. Do I work diligently in the good seasons, or grow complacent?
3. What am I laying up now that will sustain me or others later?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, teach me to steward wisely all You give me in seasons of plenty. Keep me from thoughtless consuming, and help me to work faithfully and prepare for the needs of tomorrow. Amen.
